sources.title: Maximum-Likelihood Learning of Latent Dynamics Without Reconstruction
sources.adaptation_boundary: A borrows recognition-to-latent evidence and causal filtering; not the paper's exact recognition-parametrized normalized maximum-likelihood model.

sources.title: Test-time Domain Generalization for Image Super-resolution
sources.adaptation_boundary: A soft codebooks are task adaptations; not pixel nearest-neighbor transfer or voting-based original method.

sources.title: Low Rank Based Subspace Inference for the Laplace Approximation of Bayesian Neural Networks
sources.adaptation_boundary: A uses predictive-covariance-inspired subspace in a pooled-logit GGN surrogate; no full-network target posterior guarantee.

sources.title: Weight-Space Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
sources.adaptation_boundary: B uses bounded recurrence on low-rank adapter coordinates and appearance differences, not arbitrary root-network weight recurrence on raw input differences.

sources.title: Stop Probing, Start Coding: Why Linear Probes and Sparse Autoencoders Fail at Compositional Generalization
sources.adaptation_boundary: B uses finite5step elastic-net correction; no compressed-sensing recovery theorem assumed for medical features.

sources.title: Bridge: Basis-Driven Causal Inference Marries VFMs for Domain Generalization
sources.adaptation_boundary: C uses query-conditioned low-rank bases; no proven front-door adjustment, VFM transplantation or causal anatomy disentanglement.

sources.title: Gradual Uncertainty Refinement via Noise-Driven Curriculum: A Post-Hoc Meta-Model for Robust Uncertainty Quantification
sources.adaptation_boundary: C uses residual-variance calibration with a source noise curriculum, not the original evidential classification head or its reported guarantees.
